In code the footer text, links and button share one footer row with no fill or top border; Figma stacks them. Code only: paddingSize, gapSize, radiusSize, borderSize, showBorder, onClick. onClick adds a pointer cursor only, with no role or key handling; put the action in actionButton or a link.
